import pytest

from streamlink.stream.dash.manifest import MPD, BaseURL
from streamlink.utils.parse import parse_xml


MINIMAL_MPD_TEMPLATE = """
<MPD xmlns="urn:mpeg:dash:schema:mpd:2011"
     profiles="urn:mpeg:dash:profile:isoff-live:2011"
     type="static"
     minBufferTime="PT1S"
     mediaPresentationDuration="PT1S">
  {extra}
  <Period>
    <AdaptationSet mimeType="video/mp4">
      <Representation id="v1" bandwidth="1000">
        <SegmentTemplate
          initialization="video_1920x1080_avc1/init.mp4"
          media="video_1920x1080_avc1/video-v1-$Number$.m4s"
          startNumber="1"
          duration="1" timescale="1" />
      </Representation>
    </AdaptationSet>
  </Period>
</MPD>
"""


def parse_mpd(xml_str: str, url: str | None = None) -> MPD:
    node = parse_xml(xml_str, ignore_ns=True)
    return MPD(node, url=url)


def test_derive_base_from_mpd_url_with_filename_no_query():
    xml = MINIMAL_MPD_TEMPLATE.format(extra="")
    mpd = parse_mpd(xml, url="https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/manifest.mpd")

    assert mpd.base_url == "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/"

    joined = BaseURL.join(mpd.base_url, "video_1920x1080_avc1/video-v1-1.m4s")
    assert joined == "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/video_1920x1080_avc1/video-v1-1.m4s"


def test_derive_base_from_mpd_url_with_query_and_fragment():
    xml = MINIMAL_MPD_TEMPLATE.format(extra="")
    mpd = parse_mpd(xml, url="https://example.com/path/to/manifest.mpd?x=1#frag")

    assert mpd.base_url == "https://example.com/path/to/"

    joined = BaseURL.join(mpd.base_url, "a/b/c.m4s")
    assert joined == "https://example.com/path/to/a/b/c.m4s"

    xml = MINIMAL_MPD_TEMPLATE.format(extra="")
    mpd = parse_mpd(xml, url="https://example.com/path/to/")

    assert mpd.base_url == "https://example.com/path/to/"

    joined = BaseURL.join(mpd.base_url, "seg/init.mp4")
    assert joined == "https://example.com/path/to/seg/init.mp4"


def test_explicit_baseurl_element_takes_precedence():
    baseurl_elem = "<BaseURL>https://cdn.example.net/assets/</BaseURL>"

    mpd = parse_mpd(xml, url="https://example.com/path/to/manifest.mpd")

    joined = BaseURL.join(mpd.base_url, "media/1.m4s")
    assert joined == "https://cdn.example.net/assets/media/1.m4s"

    location_elem = (

def _derive_base_directory(urlstr: str) -> str:
    """
    Derive a base directory URL from a document URL.

    - If the path ends with a filename, strip the last path segment
    - Ensure the path ends with a trailing '/'
    - Strip query and fragment components
    - Preserve scheme and netloc
    """
    parsed = urlparse(urlstr)
    path = parsed.path or ""
    if path and not path.endswith("/"):
        # remove the last path segment
        if "/" in path:
            path = path.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        else:
            path = ""
    # ensure trailing slash on non-empty path
    if path and not path.endswith("/"):
        path = path + "/"
    # if path is empty but netloc exists, keep it as empty (urlunparse will handle it)
    # Rebuild URL without params, query, fragment
    rebuilt = parsed._replace(path=path, params="", query="", fragment="")
    return urlunparse(rebuilt)
